multiple_comparisons.note: With 14688 tests, chance alone is expected to produce a best result around 4.4 sigma. A single impressive row is the base rate, not evidence. Judge must correct on hypotheses GENERATED, and use effective test count (correlated tickers/timeframes are not independent), not raw row count.

reading_guide: raw_pass_rows counts (strategy, ticker, timeframe, exit_config) rows. One strategy that works on one ticker across 9 exit configs produces 9 rows and ONE finding. Always cite distinct_findings.
